backlog.problem: Automation guidance can be repeated across root and Toolbox instructions.
backlog.proposedChange: When either file is next changed for automation policy, keep only routing there and move detailed policy to the indexed source.

evidence.unit: characters in the duplicated automation sections of AGENTS.md and toolbox/AGENTS.md

backlog.problem: Result records repeat a large structure and can require manual edits.
backlog.proposedChange: Route unchecked and checked records into separate folders and use one helper to validate, migrate, and apply confirmations without manual JSON edits.

evidence.unit: manual confirmation field and file-state edits per confirmed run
result files read during startup for the current repository state

backlog.problem: Generated module registries omitted two required boolean capabilities and required repeated manual corrections.
backlog.proposedChange: Generate explicit resultCode and png defaults in every new module registry.

evidence.unit: manual capability field additions per five-tool create run

backlog.problem: Each create run otherwise required manually repeating the tool index.html and tool.js runtime shell.
backlog.proposedChange: Generate the shared runtime shell and tool connection module from runtimePreset and ui.fields configuration.

evidence.unit: manually created embed shell and entry files per five-tool create run

backlog.problem: Completing one create configuration required invoking create, build, release, and validation commands separately.
backlog.proposedChange: Provide one runner that executes the configured stages in order and stops immediately when a stage fails.

evidence.unit: automation command invocations per five-tool create config

backlog.problem: Consolidating related tools into hubs would otherwise require repeated manual creation of hub shells, module registries, preserved anchor engines, and release metadata edits.
backlog.proposedChange: Use one machine-readable hub configuration to generate each hub runtime and synchronize hub and retired-tool release metadata.

evidence.unit: manual hub shell, module registry, and preserved anchor engine creations per eight-hub consolidation
manual release manifest metadata synchronizations per thirty-two-tool consolidation

backlog.problem: A create configuration could generate the first embed shell, but applying a shared UI-contract change afterward required rewriting every generated embed by hand.
backlog.proposedChange: Add a safe embed-only refresh mode that regenerates the five configured shells without overwriting definitions, releases, posts, or catalog metadata.

evidence.unit: manual embed shell rewrites for one five-tool create run after a shared mode-control change

backlog.problem: A single implementation, commit, and deployment could be split into several completed hard-workflow records, overstating completed runs and hiding missing evidence.
backlog.proposedChange: Define one run as one independent evidence unit and reject completed hard records without their own commit, push, and completed deployment while still allowing new-or-merge work to be chosen adaptively.
backlog.measure: invalid completed workflow records accepted by result validation

evidence.unit: superseded split records still accepted as completed hard workflows

backlog.problem: The hard plan listed numeric quotas but did not define adaptable evidence boundaries, so idea-only items or one-target fixes could be counted while useful integrated capabilities were discouraged.
backlog.proposedChange: Add a machine-readable evidence contract and validate count evidence without prescribing which features must be chosen.
backlog.measure: manual interpretations needed to decide whether three hard page-work categories count

evidence.unit: manual category-count interpretations per hard run

backlog.proposedChange: 미확인 폴더만 읽어 요약을 출력하고 같은 시각의 보고 이력을 한 번에 기록하는 report 명령을 제공한다.
